chunks: Al-Saffar narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Baraqi, from Ali ibn Idris, who said:

I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a slave-girl who was in my ownership, and I had sexual intercourse with her, then she was freed from my ownership and gave birth to a daughter. Is it permissible for my son to marry her? He said: Yes, there is no objection, before and after intercourse, they are the same.

key_terms.وَطِئْتُهَا: I had sexual intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man's son to marry the daughter of a slave-girl his father owned and had intercourse with?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the permissibility of *zawaj al-mut'ah* or permanent marriage between a father and son with a slave-girl and her daughter, specifically addressing the legal status of the daughter after her mother's manumission. Imam al-Rida (AS) affirms that the son may marry the daughter regardless of whether the father's consummation occurred before or after the mother's release from slavery, establishing a consistent precedent for familial marital alliances within the slave-owning context of early Islamic society.
